question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Ravi got the job easily because he __speaks many languages.__
solution:
The correct answer is** 'polyglot'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to substitute the given group of words **'speaks many languages'** with one word from the following options:
 
• The marked option **'Polyglot **means speaking or writing several languages,multilingual(एक से अधिक भाषा का ज्ञान या उसमें लेखन; बहुभाषी)
